description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeCSVImportAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for importing employee data from CSV files via a web service. It includes methods for handling CSV import requests, validation rules for attachments, and transaction management. The class is part of the OrangeHRM application, specifically extending the Endpoint class for API operations related to employee CSV import functionality.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for importing employee data via CSV uploads. It handles request validation, manages transaction scope, and interacts with the PimCsvDataImportService to process CSV data.

methods.name: getPimCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of PimCsvDataImportService used to process CSV imports.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the POST request to import a CSV file containing employee data, manages transaction boundaries, and returns import results.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create (import) request, especially for the attachment parameter.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines the validation rule for the 'attachment' parameter, validating its base64 content and file extension.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to fetch all resources.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to return validation rules for getAll.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for delete operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to return validation rules for delete.
